name: zetaweb-ecommerce
description: ZetaWeb Ecommerce — tienda online sobre Cloudflare Workers + Firebase (plan gratuito) + Stripe

scripts.dev: npm run shared && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --ui --project demo-tienda --import=./emulator-data --export-on-exit=./emulator-data "wrangler dev --env dev --port 5000 --ip 127.0.0.1"
scripts.dev:clean: npm run shared && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --ui --project demo-tienda "wrangler dev --env dev --port 5000 --ip 127.0.0.1"
scripts.test: npm run shared && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-tienda --only firestore,auth "node --test tests/rules/*.test.js tests/server/*.test.js"
scripts.test:e2e: node tests/e2e/shop-flow.js && node tests/e2e/admin-flow.js && node tests/e2e/admin-roles.js
